title: No-Look-Ahead and Sealed Holdout Framework
negative_results: a decode/score attempted before the holdout is sealed is refused (refuse_decode_before_seal; invariant 5)
scoring a sealed holdout more than once is refused (refuse_multiple_scoring)
a holdout item leaked into the training set is refused (refuse_holdout_in_training)
holdout labels that do not match the seal are refused at scoring time
a tampered holdout (one label changed) fails to reproduce the seal while the true holdout matches
a split of fewer than two items, or an out-of-range holdout fraction, or an empty seal is refused

claims.statement: A deterministic salted-hash train/holdout split is disjoint and covers every item, the holdout ids and geographic labels are sealed under SHA-256 before transform selection (invariant 5), and a decoder is scored once against the sealed labels (POWER: seal machinery verified, true holdout matches and a tampered one does not).
No transform may look ahead: a decode before the seal, a holdout item leaked into training, or a second scoring is refused, so a held-out score is evidence rather than a chosen result.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic opaque ids and integer labels only, no private inputs, no real coordinates
